## Meaning and tone

Does it invite reflection and choice without guilt? Does it describe elapsed time rather than private bathroom behavior? Does it clearly separate observations, assumptions, and a user-chosen age horizon?

## Review and acceptance

- [ ] Native-speaker/context review; do not infer nationality from language.
- [ ] Terminology, plurals, dates, numbers, accessible labels, and mobile text length checked.
- [ ] Country variations and fallback behavior documented.
- [ ] Calculations and user-entered goals/notes keep their meaning.
